Observation: - California State Polytechnic University, Pomona: California State Polytechnic University, Pomona (Cal Poly Pomona, CPP, or Cal Poly) is a public university in Pomona, California. It is one of two polytechnic universities in the California State University system. The university is located on 1,725 acres (698 ha) of land, making it the second largest campus in the CSU system. Cal Poly Pomona began as the southern campus of the California State Polytechnic College (Cal Poly San Luis Obispo) in 1938 and became an independent university in 1966.
- California State University, Long Beach: California State University, Long Beach (CSULB, Cal State Long Beach, or Long Beach State) is a public university in Long Beach, California. The 322-acre campus is the third largest of the 23-school California State University (CSU) system by enrollment, with a student body of 39,359 for the fall 2021 semester. It is one of the largest universities in the state of California by enrollment.
- California State University, Fullerton: California State University, Fullerton (CSUF or Cal State Fullerton) is a public university in Fullerton, California. With a total enrollment of 40,386 as of Fall 2022, it has the largest student body of the 23-campus California State University (CSU) system, and is the largest university in California in terms of enrollment. The university is designated as a Hispanic-serving institution (HSI).
